items.label: Выделить область
command: p="$HOME/.local/bin/glide-shot"; [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" --capture region || exec niri msg action screenshot

items.label: Окно
command: p="$HOME/.local/bin/glide-shot"; [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" --capture window || exec niri msg action screenshot-window

items.label: Весь экран
command: p="$HOME/.local/bin/glide-shot"; [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" --capture screen || exec niri msg action screenshot-screen
